description: Expander for the Octet Trigger Sequencer and the Nibble Trigger Sequencer, placed immediately to the right of one of them, adding a control voltage for every step of both channels

params.text: Sets the voltage sent out when that step of that channel's pattern is reached, between 0V and the level set by SCALE
Sets the top of the output range, from 1V to 8V
On, the voltage of a step is sampled when that step's gate goes high and held until another step's gate goes high; off, the outputs change on every step whether or not a gate is made

outputs.text: Carries the voltage of channel A's current step
Carries the voltage of channel A's current step with its sign reversed, so a knob turned up gives a negative voltage
Carries the voltage of channel B's current step; with the sequencer chained, what appears here is set by its Channel B chained pattern mode
Carries the voltage of channel B's current step with its sign reversed, so a knob turned up gives a negative voltage

notes: the knob pointers are grey until the expander finds a sequencer to its left, and take their colour once it is connected
menu: Channel — sets the colour of the knob pointers, Channel 1 (Red) through to Channel 7 (Green)
Initialize — puts the step knobs back to their default positions, for Channel A, Channel B or Both channels
Randomize — sets the step knobs at random, for Channel A, Channel B or Both channels
